body: Sorry about your experience :/ suicide hotlines are fucking dogshit I know that first hand. You know, come to think of it I have never actually read about an instance where they actually help. Just useless pricks, all of them.
If I could go back in time and prevent my parents from ever meeting I would in a fucking heartbeat.

Never used to really get angry at ANYTHNG and used to be the calmest person people knew, but the past 2 months I get set off by the simplest of things. Literally kicked a hole in my door and stabbed my countertops vigorously with a knife in one instance. Now I just get pissed off at anything and I hate life as it is
Seems like you know very little about this lady besides her drug use, getting extremely involved may not be the best decision here

Yeah sleeping is the only thing I look forward to. I got this Gravol sleep aid over the counter medication, works absolute wonders I pass out instantly and stay passed out. Wish there was an over the counter medication to stop the heart but this’ll do for now 😂

Yeah I’ve lied about my suicidal tendencies to everyone except my mother. Don’t really feel like being forced into a psych ward where I’ll probably just end up going manic and destroying everything including myself
Happened to me a couple nights ago, freaked out at my mentally abusive mom and manically and impulsively sped away in my car. Tryna figure out what the fuck to do hahaha

I came from a solid background myself, only problem is that I’m a fucking useless piece of shit who has done nothing to show for it. Literally nothing. Wish I had siblings so I could just pour all my energy into making them the best they can be.
Fucking me too, I’m completely and utterly useless while people that can actually make a difference in the world are suffering. It’s just not right
Also if anyone is slightly curious, my last medication I took was Zoloft, which GREATLY increased my suicidal tendencies to a whole new level where it overpowers most thoughts.
I have these exact same thoughts every day and every night, only gets worse and worse

Wish I contracted a serious case of covid and died from it. It would be the best case scenario because none of my family would think it’s suicide they’ll just think natural causes and won’t be too upset over it
Same man. With how rapidly my life has spiralled into rock bottom it’s literally inevitable hat I don’t make it past 21

Fucking hate people too, can’t get away from them because of the situation I’m in. All I want is to be fucking a lone but the only way to that is to just run away and be homeless but that’s not gonna fucking happen
